description: GTFS du réseau des transports Bus et Tramway SETRAM circulant sur le territoire Le Mans Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SETRAM. Data stops, routes and theoretical schedules of all buses and trams of the SETRAM network circulating on the territory of Le Mans Métropole. Coverage: SETRAM. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS of the transport network Bus and Tramway SETRAM circulating on the territory Le Mans Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SETRAM. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GTFS, GTFS-RT, PB. The listing shows 2026-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
